name: JPMorgan Chase & Co.

segments.note: Line-of-business revenue is on a managed (tax-equivalent) basis. Corporate (revenue $7.0B, net income $4.5B) is not shown.

sections.title: Diluted earnings per share by quarter
sections.callout: Q4 2025: diluted EPS of $4.63, down from $4.81 a year earlier.

footnotes: Banks have no cost of sales; the flow chart shows net revenue (net interest income + noninterest revenue) going to noninterest expense and the provision for credit losses, leaving income before tax. 'Professional, marketing & other' is total noninterest expense less compensation, technology and occupancy.

Line-of-business figures are on JPMorganChase's managed basis; 'Corporate, net of adj.' = reported revenue − the three main businesses, so the chart adds to reported revenue. Figures from the 2025 Form 10-K management's discussion.
Diluted EPS by quarter as reported in the 10-Qs; fourth quarters are calculated (net income ÷ estimated diluted shares) because EPS does not add across quarters.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: JPMorganChase's net revenue grew 2.8% to $182.4B in 2025. Net interest income rose 3.1% to $95.4B and noninterest revenue 2.4% to $87.0B. The Commercial & Investment Bank grew revenue 11.9% and net income 11.7% to $27.8B.

Net income dipped 2.4% to $57.0B as the provision for credit losses rose 33.1% to $14.2B and expenses grew 4.2%. Diluted EPS still rose 1.4% to $20.02, thanks to fewer shares, and return on tangible equity was 20%.
highlights: Asset & Wealth Management net income rose 20.3% to $6.5B.
Book value per share rose 9.4% to $126.99.
Dividends declared rose 20.8% to $5.80 per share.
watch: The provision for credit losses rose 33.1% to $14.2B.
Corporate segment income fell to $4.5B from $10.6B.
CET1 capital ratio fell to 14.6% from 15.7%.

revenueLine.cap: The Commercial & Investment Bank and Consumer banking each brought in about $76B–$78B.
revenueLine.say: The Commercial and Investment Bank and Consumer banking each brought in roughly 77 billion dollars.

spotlights.cap: The Commercial & Investment Bank earned $27.8B, up 11.7%.
spotlights.say: The Commercial and Investment Bank earned 27.8 billion dollars, up 11.7 percent.

spotlights.cap: Credit loss provisions rose 33.1% to $14.2B, trimming net income to $57.0B.
spotlights.say: Credit loss provisions rose 33 percent to 14.2 billion dollars, trimming net income to 57 billion.
